description: Computes the highest price that still meets the user's own targets, like the Offer tab on DoorMeter's card: for buy-and-hold per target (cash-on-cash, cash flow, DSCR); house-hack and brrrr likewise; for live-in a suggested range and the most their budget allows. For a saved deal ("key", with optional "changes" like analyze_deal) or a listing "url".

changes.description: Edits laid over the deal's own, never saved. Top-level: price, units, rentPerUnit, taxAnnual, insuranceAnnual, hoaMonthly. Groups: assumptions { interestRate (fraction, 0.0725 = 7.25%), downPaymentPct, termYears, vacancyPct, maintenancePct, managementPct, … }, houseHack { … }, brrrr { rehab, arv, … }, liveIn { monthlyBudget, value, … }. Call get_deal or list_profiles to see the field names in use.

key.description: A saved deal's key, as list_deals returns it (for example "zillow:12345").

strategy.description: Strategy the numbers are computed in: buy-and-hold, house-hack, brrrr or live-in (living in it).

url.description: A Zillow or Redfin listing URL (one home's page, e.g. a "url" from search_results).

name: max_offer
